Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:10:1.hebrew: אמר רב יהודה - גרסינן, ולא גרסינן "דאמר":
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:10:1.english: Rav Yehuda said - We read [it this way], and we do not read "for he said" [*d'amar*].

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:12:1.hebrew: כובש - את כף המאזנים של זכות, ומכריעין את העונות:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:12:1.english: Suppresses - The pan of the scales [that holds] the merits, and they outweigh the sins.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:12:2.english: He will subdue our iniquities - [The scales] will tip by it.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:12:3.hebrew: נושא - מגביה כף מאזנים של עון:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:12:3.english: Forgives [lit. lifts] - He lifts up the pan of the scales [containing] the sin.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:13:1.hebrew: מעביר ראשון ראשון - עון שבראשונים, הבאים לתתם לכף, מעבירו ושומטו. שאם היו מחצה על מחצה, כיון שחסר אחד מהן — יכרעו הזכיות. וכך היא המדה:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:13:1.english: He removes the first, first - The sin among the first ones, when they are brought to be placed on the pan [of the scale], He removes it and takes it away. For if [the sins and merits] were half and half, once one of them is lacking, the merits tip [the scale]. And such is the measure.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:13:2.hebrew: ועון עצמו אינו נמחק - אלא מונח לצד אחד, דאי איכא רובא עוונות בהדיה, ההוא עון מתחשב בהדייהו למנות עם רשעים גמורים:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:13:2.english: And the sin itself is not erased - Rather, it is set aside to one side; for if there is a majority of sins together with it, that sin is counted along with them, to be numbered with the completely wicked.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:14:1.hebrew: המעביר על מדותיו - שאינו מדקדק למדוד מדה למצערים אותו, ומניח מדותיו והולך לו. כמו "אין מעבירין על המצות" (יומא דף לג.), "אין מעבירין על האוכלין" (עירובין דף סד:) — מניחן והולך לו:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:14:1.english: One who passes over his measures - Who is not strict about measuring out [an equal] measure to those who aggrieve him, but sets aside his [own] measures and goes on his way. This is like [the expressions] "we do not pass over the commandments" (Yoma 33a) and "we do not pass over foods" (Eruvin 64b) — [meaning] he leaves them and goes on his way.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:14:2.hebrew: מעבירין לו על כל פשעיו - אין מדת הדין מדקדקת אחריהן, אלא מנחתן והולכת:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:14:2.english: They forgive him all his transgressions - The attribute of strict justice does not scrutinize them; rather, it lets them rest and moves on.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:15:1.hebrew: צביתו ליה זוודתא - הכינו לו צדה לדרך. מה היא צידת המתים? תכריכין:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:15:1.english: They prepared provisions for him - They prepared for him provisions for the journey. What are the provisions of the dead? Shrouds.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:15:3.english: Thus it was - Death was decreed upon me.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:15:4.hebrew: לא מוקים במיליה - אינו מעמיד על מדותיו:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:15:4.english: He does not stand firm on his word - He does not insist on [exacting] his [rightful] measures.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:15:5.english: Do not stand against him - Do not be exacting with him.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:16:1.hebrew: אליה - שמינה יש כאן, וקוץ בה. כלומר, דבר תנחומין יש כאן, אבל יש בתוכה דבר קשה שאינו שוה לכל:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:16:1.english: A fat tail - There is fatness here, "and a thorn in it." That is, there is a matter of consolation here, but within it is a difficult matter that is not equal for everyone.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:1:1.hebrew: ומצפצפים - צועקים ובוכים מתוך יסורין שעה אחת, ועולין:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:1:1.english: And they chirp - They cry out and weep from [their] suffering for one hour, and [then] they come up.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:2:1.hebrew: מטה כלפי חסד - הואיל ומחצה על מחצה הם, מטה את ההכרע לצד זכות, ואין יורדין לגיהנם:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:2:1.english: He tilts toward kindness - Since they are half against half [i.e., their merits and sins are evenly balanced], He tilts the decision toward the side of merit, and they do not descend to Gehinnom.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:3:1.english: With their bodies - [The Gemara] explains this below.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:1.hebrew: המינין - האנשים אשר הפכו דברי אלהים חיים לרעה, כגון צדוקים ובייתוסים:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:1.english: The minin (heretics) - The people who twisted the words of the living God for the worse, such as the Sadducees and the Boethusians.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:2.hebrew: והמסורות - מלשינים, שמוסרים ממון ישראל ביד העובדי כוכבים:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:2.english: And the informers - Slanderers who hand over the property of Israel into the hands of idolaters.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:3.english: Epikoros - One who disparages Torah scholars.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:4.hebrew: שכפרו בתורה - האומרים אין תורה מן השמים. "שפירשו מדרכי ציבור" לא גרסינן, דהיינו כל הני דלעיל. והך מתני' בסדר עולם, והכי גרסינן ליה התם: "שפירשו מדרכי הצבור", כגון המינין והמסורות כו'. מדרכי ציבור — מדרכי ישראל:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:4.english: Who denied the Torah - Those who say that the Torah is not from heaven. We do not have the reading "who separated themselves from the ways of the community," which would refer to all of these [categories] mentioned above. And this mishnah [appears] in Seder Olam, and that is how we read it there: "who separated themselves from the ways of the community," such as the heretics (minim) and the informers (masorot), etc. "From the ways of the community" means from the ways of Israel.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:5.english: And who cast their terror - [Scripture's phrase] is explained below.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:5:1.english: And their form - Like "and their shape."

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:5:2.english: Who stretched out their hands against the Zevul - For they destroyed the Temple through their sins.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:6:1.english: The people of Mechoza - They were pampered and fat.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:6:2.hebrew: ומקריין בני גיהנם - כך יקראו להם:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:6:2.english: And they are called "sons of Gehinnom" - This is what they will be called.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:8:1.hebrew: והאמרת לית לה תקנתא - דנעשין אפר, והכא "וצרפתים כצרוף את הכסף" — שימרקו יסוריהן את עוונם:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:8:1.english: But you said they have no remedy - For [the wicked] are made into ashes; whereas here [it says], "and I will refine them as silver is refined" — meaning that their sufferings will cleanse their sin.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:9:1.hebrew: דלה אני - במצות, כגון בינוניים, שאין זכיותיהן מכריעין לתלות להם בזכותם:
Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:9:1.english: I am poor - in mitzvot, such as the intermediate ones, whose merits do not tip the scale so as to suspend [judgment] for them on account of their merit.

Rashi on Rosh Hashanah 17a:9:2.english: And me He will save - By tilting [the scales] toward mercy.

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:10:1.hebrew: קרקפתא דלא מנח תפלין - אם עוסק בתורה כמניח תפלין דמי, דאמר במכילתא: העוסק בתורה פטור מן התפלין. ורבינו תם מפרש דהכא כשהמצוה בזויה עליו, שמגונות עליו רצועות של תפלין שבראשו. אבל אם ירא להניח משום דבעינן גוף נקי, כאלישע בעל כנפים כדאיתא בריש במה טומנין (שבת דף מט. ושם), והוא דואג כל שעה שמא לא יוכל להזהר לשמרה בטהרה ובקדושה — הא ודאי אין עליו דין פושעי ישראל בגופן. וכל הני דשמעתין בשלא עשה תשובה; אבל עשה תשובה, אמרינן ביומא (דף פו.): דתשובה תולה, ומיתה ממרקת:
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:10:1.english: "The skull [of one] who does not put on tefillin" - If he engages in Torah study, it is as if he puts on tefillin, for it says in the Mekhilta: One who engages in Torah study is exempt from tefillin. And Rabbeinu Tam explains that here [the case is] where the mitzvah is despised by him, such that the straps of the tefillin on his head are repugnant to him. But if he is afraid to put them on because we require a clean body — like Elisha, the Master of Wings, as stated at the beginning of [the chapter] "Bameh Tomenin" (Shabbat 49a, and there) — and he worries at every moment that he will not be able to take care to guard them in purity and holiness, certainly the law of "those among Israel who sin with their bodies" does not apply to him. And all of these [statements] in our passage refer to one who did not repent; but if he repented, we say in Yoma (86a): Repentance suspends [the punishment], and death cleanses.

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:10:2.hebrew: אמר רב בעבירה - בעריות, שכן בן נח מוזהר עליו, כדאיתא בפ' ארבע מיתות (סנהדרין דף נו.):
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:10:2.english: Rav said: [It refers to] a transgression - [namely] forbidden sexual relations, since a descendant of Noah is warned against it, as stated in the chapter "Arba Mitot" (Sanhedrin 56a):

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:2:1.hebrew: ועליהם אמר דוד אהבתי - דכתיב ביה: "אפפוני חבלי מות", וכתיב: "דלותי ולי יהושיע" — כשהוא דל במצות, רב חסד מטה ומושיע, כדדרשינן לקמן. אי נמי מלשון "דלה דלה לנו" (שמות ב׳:י״ט), שמעלהו מבור עמוק. וכתיב בתריה (תהילים קט״ז:ז׳): "שובי נפשי למנוחיכי" וגו', והדר: "אתהלך בארצות החיים":
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:2:1.english: And about them David said, "I love" - For it is written there, "The cords of death encompassed me," and it is written, "I was brought low, and He will save me" — when a person is poor in mitzvot, the One who is abundant in kindness tilts [the scales toward mercy] and saves, as we expound below. Alternatively, [dalloti is] from the language of "he drew, he drew for us" (Exodus 2:19), for He lifts him out of a deep pit. And right after it is written (Psalms 116:7): "Return, my soul, to your rest," etc., and afterward: "I will walk in the lands of the living."

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:4:1.english: The minim (heretics) - Rav Acha and Ravina disagree about this in the chapter "Ein Ma'amidin" (Avodah Zarah 26b) (what is a min) [another version].

Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:8:1.hebrew: כי לית להו תקנה ברוב עוונות - ואית בהו עון דפושעי ישראל בגופן. והא דאמר לעיל: רשעים, דהיינו רובן עוונות, נכתבים ונחתמים לאלתר לגיהנם, אע"ג דכתיב בקרא "לדראון עולם" — לא שלא יהא להם תקנה, אלא נדונים שנים עשר חדש ועולים. והא דאמר בפרק הזהב (ב"מ דף נח: ושם): שלשה יורדים ואינם עולים — היינו לאלתר. והא דאמר ריש לקיש בסוף חגיגה (דף כז. ושם): פושעי ישראל אין אור של גיהנם שולט בהן — הא אמר עלה בריש עושין פסין (עירובין דף יט. ושם): דנחית אברהם ומסיק להו:
Tosafot on Rosh Hashanah 17a:8:1.english: "For they have no remedy, due to the majority of their sins" - And among them [the Jewish sinners] is the sin of "those who sinned with their bodies." As for what [the Gemara] said above, that the wicked — meaning those whose sins are the majority — are immediately written and sealed to Gehinnom, even though the verse states "to everlasting abhorrence": [this does] not [mean] that they have no remedy; rather, they are judged for twelve months and then ascend. And as for what is stated in the chapter Hazahav (Bava Metzia 58b, there): "Three descend and do not ascend" — that refers to [descending] immediately. And as for what Reish Lakish said at the end of Chagigah (27a, there): "The fire of Gehinnom has no power over the sinners of Israel" — [this is not a difficulty, for] it was stated regarding it at the beginning of Osin Pasin (Eruvin 19a, there) that Abraham descends and brings them up.
